formal_name: CUBE-REV Generation VII G7-P19 — Untouched-Fresh Hybrid Complementarity Confirmation, Exhaustive Prior-Contact Exclusion, Minimal Fresh48 Acquisition, Frozen Full296 HAND↔HYBRID No-Retrain Evaluation, Solve-Clustered NLL Confirmation, 16-Cell Transport Diagnostics & Representation Complementarity Confirmation Campaign
interpretation: The HYBRID-versus-HAND direction generated in P17 and attributed to scale-mediated complementarity in P18 reappears on a second independently selected untouched fresh48 sample.
The effect is materially smaller than in P17 and the solve-bootstrap upper 95th percentile crosses zero, so the presealed full confirmation criterion is not met.
HYBRID has lower mean NLL and higher mean top-1 than HAND on this fresh sample, but this remains direction-only evidence.

Method and reconstructor-band marginals both retain the HYBRID-favoring direction; the era surface is heterogeneous, with E1 slightly HAND-favoring, E2 near zero, and E3/E4 more strongly HYBRID-favoring.

P19 therefore strengthens the case that raw-state information can complement handcrafted search structure, while simultaneously showing that the magnitude is not yet stable enough for a population-general confirmation claim.
retained: HANDCRAFTED_SEARCH remains a LIVE_RIVAL and cannot be demoted by P19.
The representation comparison is predictive only; neither model receives cognitive-mechanism authority.
demoted_or_forbidden: claim that HYBRID superiority is fresh-confirmed
claim that the P17 effect magnitude transports unchanged
mechanism interpretation of raw-state latent features
successor_problem: Before spending more untouched contact on the same aggregate contrast, use the two independent fresh48 cohorts and development authority to determine whether HYBRID complementarity is stable, era-localized, or effect-size nonstationary; freeze any successor contact rule only after that heterogeneity audit.
